resources.string: Set up administrator access once. Afterward, use the same paper key each time you sign in.
Enter your account password, saved paper key and a current authenticator code. Do not generate a new paper key.
1 · Connect an authenticator
2 · Save your paper key
3 · Enter the code and sign in
On this phone: copy the setup secret, open your authenticator and add an account using a setup key (time-based). On another device: scan the QR code. These are two ways to add the same account.
Authenticator setup secret — not the sign-in code
Copy setup secret
Copied. Paste it into your authenticator.
You can switch to your authenticator and return within 3 minutes. The unfinished form stays only in memory. Closing this screen clears it.
Generate this key once and write down all 4 groups of 8 characters. It becomes active after your first successful sign-in. Keep using that same key afterward.
I already wrote down a key
Generate a different key?
This replaces only the unfinished setup key on this screen. Cross out the previous copy and write down the new one. Your server key is unchanged until sign-in succeeds.
Generate a different key
Cancel
Open your authenticator and enter the current 6-digit UNYRI code below. This is not the long setup secret or your paper key. A saved recovery code is also accepted.
The form was cleared after a long absence. Enter your saved paper key again. If authenticator setup was not finished, repeat step 1.
Finish connecting the authenticator first.
Authenticator setup lasts 10 minutes. If it expires, reconnect the authenticator; your written paper key can be reused.
Use authenticator code
Use a recovery code
Saved recovery code
6-digit authenticator code
Enter a saved 43-character recovery code.
Enter 6 digits from your authenticator. Add the long setup secret to the authenticator first; it is not a sign-in code.
The server rejected sign-in. Check your account password and the current authenticator code. This does not mean the code alone is wrong.
Too many attempts. Wait 5 minutes before trying again.
The server could not complete the request. Contact the server owner.
Could not connect securely to the server. Check the network and server certificate.
